title: How Far in Advance Should You Book a Private Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: For July, August, Easter and New Year, book a private boat trip in Madeira 3 to 4 weeks ahead. In quiet months a few days can work. Here is how to plan it.
heroAlt: White motor boat with grey seats tied to a pontoon at Marina do Funchal in early morning light
